description: EngineExecutor (plan §8): the one thread (C#, C) or actor (Swift) that owns all service state. post(action) may be called from any thread; actions run one at a time, in the order they were posted (per posting thread), never inside post itself, even when post is called on the executor. isCurrent is true only on the executor (C#, C; Swift's EngineActor isolation is checked by the compiler). worker(work) runs work on a worker thread, off the executor, and delivers its result or its BroError back on the executor; workers run in parallel. barrier() waits until every action posted before it has run. stop() lets the queued actions run, then ends the executor; an action posted afterwards doesn't run (post says so). These cases are behaviours each platform's harness checks natively; 'given' holds their sizes. busyWhilePosting: the harness keeps the executor busy (an action waiting for it) until 'first' and 'second' are both posted, so 'second' is queued before 'first' runs.

expect.order: each thread's actions as it posted them
